name: notify
description: Notifications that say what happened: a long turn finished (with its answer), a permission prompt or a question waiting, an Actions budget running low; on the desktop and, through Claude Code push, on your phone

desktop.title: Desktop notifications
desktop.description: Show a native notification on the desktop of the machine Claude Code runs on

push.title: Phone notifications
push.description: Also send each notification through Claude Code's own push: it reaches the Claude app on your phone when you are away from the terminal

done.title: A long turn finished
done.description: Notify when a turn longer than the shortest turn below finishes, with the first line of the answer

permission.title: A permission prompt is waiting
permission.description: Notify when a permission prompt is still unanswered after the wait below

question.title: A question is waiting
question.description: Notify when a question Claude asked is still unanswered after the wait below

budget.title: An Actions budget is running low
budget.description: With the ci-budget mod installed: notify when the repo owner's Actions usage reaches the percentage below, and again at 100%

budgetPercent.title: Budget notification at (%)
budgetPercent.description: Share of the included Actions minutes that triggers the budget notification

minSeconds.title: Shortest turn to notify about
minSeconds.description: A turn that finishes sooner sends no notification, in seconds

permissionDelaySeconds.title: Wait before notifying about a prompt
permissionDelaySeconds.description: A permission prompt or question answered within this many seconds sends no notification

speak.title: Also read it aloud
speak.description: Speak the notification with the system voice
